# flutter_bluetooth_serial

Vendored from [flutter_bluetooth_serial 0.4.0](https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_bluetooth_serial/versions/0.4.0), maintained upstream at [edufolly/flutter_bluetooth_serial](https://github.com/edufolly/flutter_bluetooth_serial).

Upstream credits Eduardo Folly, Martin Mauch and Patryk Ludwikowski. The package is third-party software under the [MIT license](LICENSE); its source and documentation retain their upstream attribution.

The local Android build declares the plugin namespace and uses compile SDK 36 for compatibility with this app's Android build. See [android/build.gradle](android/build.gradle). These integration settings do not transfer authorship of the plugin to UnfoLDAR.

The license text was restored from the [published package license](https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_bluetooth_serial/license).
